title: [Koyu Booking Link] - In-app Booking Path - Logged-in User - Existing Flow Preserved
description: AC 01.5 - Regression Analysis - Existing app flow remains Login > Calendar > Booking system > Master Event > Activity Event List > Detail > Reserve.
preconditions:
- User S2 is already logged in.
- Event A under EM-1001 is available for booking in app flow.
- No booking-link URL is used in this case.
steps_actions:
1. From app home, open Calendar then Booking system.
2. Open Master Event EM-1001 then Event A detail.
3. Tap Reserve on Event A detail.
steps_result:
1. Existing in-app route opens without unexpected auth gate.
2. Event A detail is displayed in logged-in flow.
3. Booking continues directly with no Login/Register detour.
steps_data:
1. entry_path = login>calendar>booking_system
2. master_event = EM-1001; event = Event A
3. user_state = logged_in; expected_auth_redirect = none

preconditions:

- Direct Event A detail path/URL is available.

steps_actions:

steps_result:

3. Behavior is equivalent to baseline for logged-in direct navigation.
steps_data:
